title: Celebrations
seoDescription: Host celebrations at Cococabana in Oceanside with rooftop views, cocktails, food, and a coastal private event setting.
heroText: A rooftop setting for social celebrations in Oceanside.

heroImage.alt: Women dining and celebrating on Coco Cabana rooftop with cocktails and palm views

sections.title: Built for the Occasion
text: Weekend daytime events have access to our brunch program — mimosas and rooftop plates for a celebration worth showing up for.
sections.imageAlt: Campo Viejo cava mimosa flight on marble table with flamingo and tropical plants

sections.title:
The Rooftop
Is Yours
text: Four stories above 408 Pier View Way — open air, full bar, and the kind of view that makes every moment feel like it matters.
sections.imageAlt: Group celebrating at Coco Cabana rooftop with cocktails and the gold pineapple wall

sections.title: A Setting That Does the Work
text:
Palm trees, cabana seating, signature lighting, and the Pacific coastline — Coco Cabana handles the ambiance so your crew can just enjoy the celebration.

Planning a daytime brunch event? Our weekend brunch program brings mimosas and rooftop plates to the table. Evening events have access to the full cocktail bar and DJ nights every Friday and Saturday.
sections.imageAlt: Coco Cabana rooftop lounge with pink daybeds, tile wall, and Oceanside city views at dusk

steps.title: Inquire Below
steps.text: Fill out the inquiry form with your event date, party size, and any details. Or call us directly at (858) 304-7725.

steps.title: We Build the Plan
steps.text: We'll follow up within 1 business day to confirm availability and put together the details for your celebration.

steps.title: Enjoy the Rooftop
steps.text: Show up, settle in, and let the rooftop do the rest. We'll handle everything so you can focus on the celebration.
